head.t: NHS Supply Chain's £113m Negative Pressure Wound Therapy framework names six suppliers
head.x: NHS Supply Chain has signed six suppliers to its new Negative Pressure Wound Therapy (NPWT) framework, worth an estimated £113m over its four-year term to March 2031.
SUPPLY CHAIN COORDINATION LIMITED. NHS Supply Chain intends to launch a National Framework Agreement for the provision of Genetic Hearing Loss Solutions.

head.t: NHS Supply Chain reports first IV Cannula awarded supplier day, second set for Manchester on 26 November
head.x: NHS Supply Chain brought trusts and every awarded supplier on its new Intravenous Cannula and Associated Products framework together at Newbury Racecourse on 15 October, so clinicians and procurement could compare products side by side and discuss implementation, training and supply resilience.

f.t: RPA Dental Equipment wins £38.5k digital X-ray unit replacement at Betsi Cadwaladr
f.x: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has direct-awarded RPA Dental Equipment Limited a £38,500 contract for seven digital X-ray units across its community dental sites, called off under the NHS Supply Chain Dental Technologies, Implants and Related Consumables and Services framework.

f.t: NHS Supply Chain awards National Respiratory Solutions Framework across 5 lots
f.x: NHS Supply Chain has made award decisions on its new National Framework Agreement for Respiratory Solutions, covering respiratory therapy, anaesthesia and resuscitation, diagnostics and monitoring, nitrous oxide destruction, and respiratory support services.

f.t: Cambridge University Hospitals awards insulin pump contract to Medtrum
f.x: Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust has awarded a contract for insulin pumps and consumables to Medtrum Ltd, drawing on the NHS Supply Chain Insulin Pumps, CGM and Hybrid Closed Loop framework.

f.t: Oxford Health NHS FT: Wound Care Formulary, September 2025
f.x: Lists RespoSorb Silicone Border in seven sizes with NHS Supply Chain codes (e.g. EJA254), Atrauman and Cosmopor. Under compression it names Kliniderm Superabsorbent and RespoSorb Silicone Border.
